You Can't See Me is awarded to players who defeat The Bloodbound Horror after all players are Slimed! and then defeat a Volatile Ooze in Nerub-ar Palace on Normal or higher difficulties. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Nerub-ar Raider. This achievement requires 10 players at minimum, and all players must be alive, Slimed at the same time, and standing on top of each other to spawn the ooze. To begin, have all players get hit by the Gruesome Disgorge frontal and sent downstairs. Half the players should clear out the usual adds, while the other half should explore the outer edges of the arena for small untargetable slimes, which should be run over. You Awaken in Razor Hill is a comedy/horror fan story written by Alex Levinton (also known as Dusk) and originally posted in the Uldum US realm board on the World of Warcraft forum. It ran from 25 October to 20 November 2009 including the final epilogue. The story is styled as an interactive text-based , written in second person, that allowed forumgoers to give commands by commenting in the thread and thereby control the protagonist's actions and the course of the story. The format is inspired by , while the plot and setting are a loose parody of (Levinton chose Razor Hill as the main setting because of the similar name). Young Crocolisks are baby crocolisks that spawn upon touching Croc Eggs at the Pit of Scales in Uldum. This even has to be done after killing them, as their corpses will stay on the player, and the debuff will still be up.

Your Reward has Arrived! is available to those that have the WoW Collector's Edition - 2024 Employee Holiday Gift tied to their account. Zekvir is a nerubian hulk playing the role as the delves nemesis during The War Within Season 1. He also has a chance to ambush players during a normal delve starting at tier 4 difficulty. While in an encounter with other mobs in a delve, Zekvir has a chance to ambush the encounter. During this time, getting Zekvir down to 50% health will cause him to retreat and leave behind a Hulking Raptorial Claw, otherwise killing all players will promptly have him leave the delve with no reward left behind.
Zealous Ironguard are ironstriders found in the Ringing Deeps.

Zarein served as Stormward Baelgrim's stormrook till Baelgrim's valiant death in Cinderbrew Meadery. Distraught by his riders' death, Zarein wandered around Cinderwold till, some time later, he was found by Olbarig, Baelgrim's old Stormguard, who had come to the place to pay respects to the fallen Stormward. Shocked that Zarein had not returned to Skywall, Olbarig found that the stormrook had been mourning Baelgrim as well. Despite their previous arguments over the binding of the stormrooks, Baelgrim had in fact bonded with his rook, with Zarein choosing to serve rather than be subjugated. Zarama was the wife of Man'ye, son of the mighty warlord Zul'jin and heir to the Amani. After the death of Man'ye and Zul'jin, the Amani were plunged into a succession crisis, as Man'ye's own children were too young to rule. In the interim, Zarama ruled as chieftain of the Amani until her daughter, Zul'jarra, was of age.
